$source: Archer's common-tier colour roles, from this profile's authoring.md: --color-text-*, --color-background-*, --color-border-*. Only the colour family is declared — it is the one whose role is the segment after the type. The base palette (--color-neutral-600), the brand action (--color-primary-*) and every other family (--space-*, --radius-1…6, --size-*) carry no role segment, so they stay on the engine's generic table and are never reported as misapplied.
